notes.title: Release 1 day away
notes.notes:
[b][h1]Rick Rack is ready for release ![/h1][/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34947671/b4988971d217a319427df399327ddba22549ad21.jpg[/img]


I can't wait to show the stories of these 15 people and how their decisions is going to change the course of the city's destiny.
I hope you all enjoy as much as I enjoy developing the game and playing it myself.

Mac and Linux versions will require testing as I own neither of those. Please direct message me or post on the forum for related issues. Dedicated forum topics have been created.

Enjoy time rewinding.
